description: A real executor runs plan 01-01 of the two-plan seed (two tasks) through `/pan:exec-phase 1 --plan 01-01 --fast`. Each task's commit must end with its `PAN-Step: 01-01/task-N` line; with the journal set aside, the installed engine must prove both tasks from those commits alone, and after a simulated crash takes the newest task commit, resume at the task that commit held.
why: Self-recording step journal (spec self_recording_journal_featureai.md): the tier-0 scenario resume-from-trailers proves the engine reads trailers that a script wrote. This proves the other half: that the executor, following its commit template, writes them. If a model drops the line, resume silently falls back to restarting the plan at task 1, so this is the only scenario that would notice.

steps.why: The executor finished the plan: both task files and its summary exist.

Both tasks' commits carry their PAN-Step line; the commits alone prove the plan done; and after the crash takes the newest task commit, resume starts at the task it held (task-2, or task-1 when the executor coalesced both tasks into one commit).
